mn138:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn138:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn138:2.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn138:3.1: Tathā tathā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu upaparikkheyya yathā yathā 'ssa upaparikkhato bahiddhā c' assa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭaṃ ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ anupādāya na paritasseyya;
mn138:3.2: bahiddhā, bhikkhave, viññāṇe avikkhitte avisaṭe sati ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhite, anupādāya aparitassato āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇadukkhasamudayasambhavo na hotīti.
mn138:4.2: idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
mn138:5.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:--
mn138:5.2: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:5.3: Tathā tathā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu upaparikkheyya yathā yathā 'ssa upaparikkhato bahiddhā c' assa viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭaṃ ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitaṃ anupādāya na paritasseyya;
mn138:5.4: bahiddhā, bhikkhave, viññāṇe avikkhitte avisaṭe sati ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhite, anupādāya aparitassato āyatiṃ jātijarāmaraṇadukkhasamudayasambhavo na hotīti.
mn138:5.5: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
mn138:5.6: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ etad ahosi:
mn138:5.7: Ayaṃ kho āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ,
mn138:5.8: pahoti c' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ;
mn138:5.9: yannūna mayaṃ yen' āyasmā MahāKaccāno ten' upasaṃkameyyāma upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāmāti.
mn138:6.1: Atha kho te bhikkhū yen' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu upasaṃkamitvā āyasmatā Mahā-Kaccānena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu
mn138:6.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
mn138:6.3: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso Kaccāna, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:6.6: Tesan no, āvuso Kaccāna, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
mn138:6.7: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā . . . vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:6.10: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
mn138:6.11: Tesan no, āvuso Kaccāna, amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
mn138:7.1: Seyyathāpi, āvuso, puriso sāratthiko sāragavesī sārapariyesanañ caramāno mahato rukkhassa tiṭṭhato sāravato atikkamm' eva mūlaṃ atikamma khandhaṃ sākhāphalāse sāraṃ pariyesitabbaṃ maññeyya, --
mn138:7.2: evaṃ-sampadam idaṃ. Āyasmantānaṃ Satthari sammukhībhūte taṃ Bhagavantaṃ atisitvā amhe etam atthaṃ paṭipucchitabbaṃ maññatha.
mn138:7.3: So h', āvuso, Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammasāmī Tathāgato.
mn138:7.4: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo ahosi yaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yeva etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha;
mn138:7.5: yathā vo Bhagavā byākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāthāti.
mn138:8.1: Addhā, 'vuso Kaccāna, Bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti passaṃ passati cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā amatassa dātā dhammasāmī Tathāgato.
mn138:8.2: So c' eva pan' etassa kālo yaṃ Bhagavantaṃ yeva etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyāma;
mn138:8.3: yathā no Bhagavā byākareyya, tathā naṃ dhāreyyāma.
mn138:8.4: Āpi c' āyasmā MahāKaccāno Satthu c' eva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
mn138:8.5: pahoti c' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ.
mn138:9.1: Tena h', āvuso, suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti
mn138:9.2: Evam āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahā-Kaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
mn138:9.4: Yaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:9.5: Tathā tathā, bhikkhave, bhikkhu . . . na hotīti, --
mn138:9.6: imassa kho ahaṃ, āvuso, Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
mn138:10.1: Kathañ c', āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan ti vuccati?
mn138:10.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā rūpanimittānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti rūpanimittassādagathitaṃ rūpanimittassādavinibaddhaṃ rūpanimittassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan ti vuccati.
mn138:10.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhamanimittānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti dhammanimittassādagathitaṃ dhammanimittassādavinibaddhaṃ dhammanimittassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan ti vuccati. --
mn138:10.8: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan ti vuccati.
mn138:11.1: Kathañ c', āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan ti vuccati?
mn138:11.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhuno cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na rūpanimittānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na rūpanimittassādagathitaṃ na rūpanimittassādasaṃyojanosaṃyuttaṃ, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan ti vuccati.
mn138:11.7: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na dhammanimittānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na dhammanimittassādagathitaṃ na dhammanimittassādavinibaddhaṃ na dhammanimittassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan ti vuccati. --
mn138:11.8: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan ti vuccati.
mn138:12.1: Kathañ c', āvuso, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan ti vuccati?
mn138:12.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicc akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:12.3: Tassa vivekajapītisukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti vivekajapītisukhassādagathitaṃ vivekajapītisukhassādavinibaddhaṃ vivekajapītisukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:13.1: Puna ca paraṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:13.2: Tassa samādhijapītisukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti samādhijapītisukhassādagathitaṃ samādhijapītisukhassādavinibaddhaṃ samādhijapītisukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:14.1: Puna ca paraṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati, sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti yan taṃ ariyā acikkhanti:-- Upekhako satimā sukhavihārīti, tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:14.2: Tassa upekhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti upekhāsukhassādagathitaṃ upekhāsukhassādavinibaddhaṃ upekhāsukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:15.1: Puna ca paraṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthagamā adukkhaṃasukhaṃ upekhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:15.2: Tassa adukkhamasukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti adukkhamasukhassādagathitaṃ adukkhamasukhassādavinibaddhaṃ adukkhamasukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan ti vuccati. --
mn138:15.3: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ saṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:16.1: Kathañ c', āvuso, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ asaṇṭhitan ti vuccati?
mn138:16.2: Idh', āvuso, bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi --pe-paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:16.3: Tassa na vivekajapītisukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na vivekajapītisukhassādagathitaṃ na vivekajapītisukhassādavinibaddhaṃ na vivekajapītisukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ , ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ asaṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:17.1: Puna ca paraṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā --pe-- dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:17.2: Tassa na samādhijapītisukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na samādhijapītisukhassādagathitaṃ na samādhijapītisukhassādavinibaddhaṃ na samādhijapītisukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ asaṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:18.1: Puna ca paraṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu pītiyā ca virāgā --pe-tatiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:18.2: Tassa na upekhāsukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na upekhāsukhassādagathitaṃ na upekhāsukhassādavinibaddhaṃ na upekhāsukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ asaṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:19.1: Puna ca paraṃ, āvuso, bhikkhu, sukhassa ca pahānā --pe-- catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
mn138:19.2: Tassa na adukkhamasukhānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na adukkhamasukhassādagathitaṃ na adukkhamasukhassādavinibaddhaṃ na adukkhamasukhassādasaṃyojanasaṃyuttaṃ, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ asaṇṭhitan ti vuccati. --
mn138:19.3: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, ajjhattaṃ cittaṃ asaṇṭhitan ti vuccati.
mn138:20.1: Kathañ c', āvuso, anupādā paritassanā hoti?
mn138:20.2: Idh', āvuso, asutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
mn138:20.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā rūpaṃ rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn138:20.4: Tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇāmati aññathā hoti,
mn138:20.6: tassa rūpaṃ vipariṇāmānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti, tassa rūpavipariṇāmānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti,
mn138:20.7: cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca upekhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati.
mn138:20.11: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ attani vā viññāṇaṃ viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn138:20.12: Tassa taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇāmati aññāthā hoti,
mn138:20.14: tassa viññāṇavipariṇāmānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti,
mn138:20.15: cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca upekhavā ca anupādāya ca paritassati. --
mn138:20.16: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, anupādā paritassanā hoti.
mn138:21.1: Kathañ c', āvuso, anupādā aparitassanā hoti?
mn138:21.2: Idh', āvuso, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto
mn138:21.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn138:21.4: Tassa taṃ rūpaṃ vipariṇāmati aññathā hoti,
mn138:21.5: tassa rūpavipariṇāmaññathābhāvā na rūpavipariṇāmānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti,
mn138:21.6: tassa na rūpavipariṇāmānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti,
mn138:21.7: cetaso apariyādānā na c' ev' uttāsavā hoti na ca vighātavā na ca upekhavā anupādāya ca na paritassati.
mn138:21.11: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ.
mn138:21.12: Tassa taṃ viññāṇaṃ vipariṇāmati aññathā hoti,
mn138:21.13: tassa viññāṇavipariṇāmaññathābhāvā na viññāṇavipariṇāmānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti,
mn138:21.14: tassa na viññāṇavipariṇāmānuparivattajā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti,
mn138:21.15: cetaso pariyādānā na c' ev' uttāsavā hoti na ca vighātavā na ca upekhavā anupādāya ca na paritassati. --
mn138:21.16: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, anupādā aparitassanā hoti.
mn138:22.1: Yaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:22.4: imassa kho ahaṃ, āvuso, Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmi.
mn138:22.5: Ākaṅkhamānā ca pana tumhe āyasmanto Bhagavantaṃ yeva upasaṃkamitvā etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha.
mn138:22.6: Yathā vo Bhagavā byākaroti, tathā naṃ dhāreyyathāti.
mn138:23.1: Atha kho te bhikkhu āyasmato Mahā-Kaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
mn138:23.2: Yaṃ kho no, bhante, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā vitthārena atthaṃ avibhajitvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:23.5: tesan no, bhante, amhākaṃ acirapakkantassa Bhagavato etad ahosi:
mn138:23.6: Idaṃ kho no, āvuso, Bhagavā saṃkhittena uddesaṃ uddisitvā . . . vihāraṃ paviṭṭho:
mn138:23.9: Ko nu kho imassa Bhagavatā saṃkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti?
mn138:23.10: Tesan no, bhante, amhākaṃ etad ahosi:
mn138:23.14: Atha kho mayaṃ, bhante, yen' āyasmā Mahā-Kaccāno ten' upasaṃkamimha upasaṃkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahā-Kaccānaṃ etam atthaṃ paṭipucchimha.
mn138:23.15: Tesan no, bhante, āyasmatā Mahā-Kaccānena imehi ākārehi imehi padehi imehi byañjanehi attho vibhatto ti.
mn138:24.1: Paṇḍito, bhikkhave, Mahā-Kaccāno; mahāpañño, bhikkhave, Mahā-Kaccāno.
mn138:24.2: Mañ ce pi tumhe, bhikkhave, etam atthaṃ paṭipuccheyyātha, aham pi taṃ evam evaṃ byākareyyaṃ, yathā taṃ Mahā-Kaccānena byākataṃ.
mn138:24.3: Eso c' etassa attho evañ ca naṃ dhārethāti.
mn138:24.5: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
